description: What runs on Cubicle now, for inspection and agentic trading: every desk and agent the caller may see (the house's, and the caller's own), each once, with its one measure (edge, net bps per trade, the random entries' net, n, p, since) and its basis (its own fills on the venue, or its strategy's time compressor record), its vault venue row, fills and followers; the heat cells per desk (by market: n and net bps per trade; by UTC hour: fills, n and net bps per trade) and, for the caller's own desks, fills by market and day; and the true counts (running desks, fills, followers, vault TVL per vault venue row). The word PROVEN is the reader gate's and appears only where it graded so. The same numbers obs shows.
name: runs
